title: Facts at different grains sharing conformed dimensions
description: Three fact tables at different grains, FactServiceEvent, FactRequestDaily and FactOrderLine, each relate many facts to one key in the shared conformed dimensions. Aggregate to an agreed common grain before comparing facts.

nodes.label: Conformed dimensions
nodes.detail: Date, customer, product, business unit; governed keys and history

nodes.label: FactServiceEvent
nodes.detail: One row per source event and version; event and ingestion time

nodes.label: FactRequestDaily
nodes.detail: One row per request per day; end-of-day state

nodes.label: FactOrderLine
nodes.detail: One row per order line; quantity and currency
